requestBody.query: remove an account from my bell

200.answer:
To remove an account from MyBell:
1. Navigate to bell.ca with a browser.
2. Click Log in/Register.
3. Enter your MyBell username and password and click Log in.
4. Click My profile.
5. Remove the bill you want to remove.
